name: clipkit-repository
description: ClipKit npm workspace and repository commands

scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:styles && npm run test:unit && npm run test:tokens && npm run build
scripts.build:library: npm run build:ui && npm run build --workspace @clipkit/library
scripts.build:storybook: npm run build:ui && npm run build-storybook --workspace @clipkit/ui
scripts.check:foundation: npm run check:token-parity && npm run build:library && npm run typecheck --workspace @clipkit/ui && npm run lint:foundation && npm run format:foundation:check
scripts.format:foundation: prettier --write packages/ui/src packages/ui/.storybook packages/ui/panda.config.ts apps/library/src apps/library/*.ts packages/design-tokens/src
scripts.format:foundation:check: prettier --check packages/ui/src packages/ui/.storybook packages/ui/panda.config.ts apps/library/src apps/library/*.ts packages/design-tokens/src
